_meta.description: This is the canonical schema for a pipeline job object. Every field that any stage will ever write is defined here with its type and which stage populates it. Stages must never add ad-hoc fields outside this schema.

job_id: string — uuid4, assigned at job creation
status: one of: created | stage_1_complete | stage_2_complete | stage_3_complete | stage_4_complete | stage_5_complete | complete | error
aspect_ratio: one of: 9:16 | 16:9 — output video format. 9:16 = 1080×1920 (YouTube Shorts), 16:9 = 1920×1080 (standard landscape). Default: 9:16

error.retries: int — how many times this stage was retried

study.topic: string — topic from niche_profile.topic_rotation that seeded this search
study.pubmed_query: string — exact query sent to PubMed
study.title: string
study.study_type: one of: meta_analysis | systematic_review | rct | cohort | cross_sectional | other
study.pdf_text: string — first 8000 chars of extracted PDF text, or null if unavailable
study.screenshot_paths: list of strings — local paths to figure/abstract screenshots

claims.core_finding: string — one sentence, exactly what the study found
claims.effect_size: string — exact number with units e.g. '23% reduction' or 'HR 0.78'
claims.follow_up_duration: string or null — e.g. '12 weeks', '5 years'
claims.small_study_flag: bool — true if sample_size < threshold in niche_profile
claims.key_stats: list of strings — supporting statistics beyond the primary finding
claims.methodology_summary: string or null — 1-2 sentence study design summary (blinding, recruitment, follow-up, setting)

content.hindi_script: string — full voiceover script in Hindi

script_segments.name: string — segment name matching niche_profile segment_structure

content.title: string — YouTube title in Hindi, under 60 chars
content.tags: list of strings — 15 tags mixing Hindi and English

broll_search_tags.search_terms: list of strings — English terms for Pexels/Pixabay

content.validation_notes: list of strings — any warnings from Pydantic validation

broll_video_paths.paths: list of strings — 2 downloaded options per segment

assets.srt_path: string — path to SRT caption file
assets.ass_path: string — path to ASS burn-in caption file
assets.whisper_word_timestamps: list — raw Whisper output, segment-level timestamps
assets.background_music_path: string — path to selected track from local library

output.youtube_upload_id: string — YouTube video ID after upload
output.thumbnails_uploaded: list of strings — YouTube thumbnail IDs
